title: Sourcing Commodity Manager – Optics - CW & Pump Lasers
locations: San Jose, California, United States of America
teaser: We are looking for a Sourcing Commodity Manager to drive sourcing activities for high power lasers and pump lasers within the Optics and Photonics sector. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, manage supplier relationships, and implement sourcing strategies. Ideal candidates bring significant technical expertise and experience in optics and photonics sourcing.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 09/28/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

This is a hybrid role based twice in a week at the Cisco Office.

Meet The Team

Did you know? Cisco Supply Chain was just confirmed for the 7th year running in the top 5 of the “Gartner’s annual Supply Chain Top 25” rank, which identifies supply chain leaders and highlights their standard processes. There’s never been a better time to join us!

The Global Supplier Management (GSM) Organization is an industry leader in sourcing and supplier management that enables sustained innovation and supply chain excellence. You will join a very motivated team that achieves record setting results and a fun group that helps each other be successful at work and play.

Our team focus is to drive technology and product innovation, striking a balance between performance, quality, cost, high-volume manufacturing and delivery requirements. We accomplish this by collaborating very closely with external partners and suppliers, but also with all the internal cross-functional teams: Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Manufacturing, Marketing and Legal.

You will work with all hardware engineering teams across Cisco, to understand their product roadmap and needs. You will drive early technology sensing across the industry, orchestrate roadmap reviews between Cisco and suppliers, identify and propose solutions, assess suppliers capabilities to meet both technical and business requirements.

Your Impact

You possess solid technical background, expertise on Optics and Photonics Components technologies, knowledge of market trends and industry players. You have a good understanding of key processes, requirements and challenges related to design, fabrication, testing and quality of Optical products for Communication and Networking.

You combine technical acumen with business sensibility and attitude to interpersonal communication and relationship management. You'll use your knowledgeability, trustworthiness, and accountability to build strong partnerships both inside and outside Cisco, to drive sourcing activities and decisions in agreement with company strategy and goals.

Cisco Global Supplier Management (GSM) team is seeking a motivated Sourcing Commodity Manager for “High Power Lasers, Pump Lasers, CW Lasers, ELSFP”. You will be part of a highly impactful and dynamic organization collaborating with cross-functional teams and suppliers.

Provide industry knowledge and understanding of Optics and Photonics components fabrication technologies and market trends (cost, technology, supply chain ecosystem, etc.).

Collaborate with Business Unit partners to understand the long-term requirements, map requirements into supply base offering, work to close roadmap gaps, facilitate optimal component selection

Define and implement sourcing decision aligned with Commodity strategy, perform risk assessment and mitigation plans, identify and develop alternate technical solutions.

Be part of large, complex programs involving multiple players, locations and Business Units.

Be responsible and accountable for supplier relationship management during development and NPI phase, until product release (including technical, commercial, protos delivery, and quality aspects)

Negotiating, and driving all aspects/terms of legal agreements to protect and define development phase: NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement), DLA (Development and License Agreement), SOW (Statement of Work). 

Exceptional data analytics and reporting skills, with the ability to translate sophisticated data and requirements into clear technical and business insights.

Ability to develop and execute short-, mid-, and long-term strategies.

Identify and promote solutions to sophisticated technical and business situations.

Minimum Qualifications

MS (or equivalent) in technical subjects, with 7+ years of proven experience
- Could be a combination of engineering design with business strategy or supply chain experience.

Knowledge and understanding of Optical technologies and fabrication processes (including III-V, SiPhotonics, PLCs, pluggable transceivers, etc.)

Deep technical expertise on key Components (optical and non-optical) used in Optical Systems for communications and networking applications.

Knowledge of the Optical Communications, Photonics and Networking Industry and ecosystems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in design, fabrication, testing of lasers for Optical Communications.

Technical and business-related problem solving skills.

Strong interpersonal communication and relationship management skills.

Demonstrates leading constructive discussions, taking ownership, managing emotions with empathy, and supporting team growth.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks.  Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

.75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

1.5% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 50% and 75%;

1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

Once performance exceeds 100% attainment, incentive rates are at or above 1% for each 1% of attainment with no cap on incentive compensation.

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.
